name: Exposing False Teachers
overview: Scripture warns believers to be vigilant against false teachers who appear harmless but inwardly seek to deceive and divide the church. Jesus cautions that not all who claim Him as Lord truly do the will of the Father, emphasizing the importance of genuine obedience. Paul exhorts the church to recognize and avoid those who promote teachings contrary to the gospel of Christ, urging believers to reject philosophies and human traditions that lead them astray. Instead, Christians are called to expose and reprove the unfruitful works of darkness, maintaining faithfulness to the true doctrine revealed in Christ.
